data.body: Root cause confirmed from run 33035272265 vs last green run 32696579734: the DC Lucene reindex latency on the ephemeral CI instance routinely runs 83-90s (green run's own per-test setup times: 90.73s, 83.30s), leaving ~0 margin against the fixed 90s search-visibility budget. This run it exceeded 90s -> both rich-text tests failed in _wait_until_search_reflects (write landed, SEARCH lagged). Fix: default budget 90s -> 240s, env-tunable via REBAR_DC_SEARCH_INDEX_TIMEOUT, mirroring 1d21's Cloud search-index-lag hardening. Pushed as Gerrit change 2262. Validation: re-dispatched Live External run must show DC lane GREEN.
